sources.title: google/gemma-2-27b-it model card
sources.evidence: Exact instruction-tuned repository; Google authorship, Gemma license, text input/output, open pretrained and instruction-tuned weights, and native bfloat16 export. Public model card is readable; raw repository files require gated access. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact Google card retains the nominal 27B instruction-tuned identity and gives no separately defined active count.

sources.title: Fine-tuning Gemma 2 with Keras - and an update from Hugging Face
sources.evidence: Dated June 27, 2024; announces availability of both 9B and 27B Gemma 2 sizes with standard and instruction-tuned variants, linking their downloads.

sources.title: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size, v3
sources.evidence: Decoder-only Transformer with alternating local/global attention, GQA, 8192 context and tied embeddings. Tables 1-2 give 46 layers, width 4608, vocabulary 256128, 1,180,237,824 embedding and 26,047,480,320 nonembedding parameters for 27B. Fresh October 27 full-report review confirms these counts. Section 6 expressly says comparisons use total rather than active parameters; the nonembedding subtotal is not an active-count disclosure. The 27B model is trained from scratch rather than distilled from a named count-bearing teacher.

sources.title: Pinned official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Google weights
sources.evidence: Revision aaf20e6b9f4c0fcf043f6fb2a2068419086d77b0 reports safetensors.parameters.BF16 = 27227128320 and safetensors.total = 27227128320. Also identifies Gemma2ForCausalLM, the base model google/gemma-2-27b, Gemma license and user/model chat template. This is repository tensor aggregation, not independently downloaded tensor headers. Reopened October 27, 2026; the pinned API still reports exactly 27,227,128,320 BF16 parameters. No weight payload was downloaded or tensor census repeated.

sources.title: Official Gemma PyTorch configuration, pinned revision
sources.evidence: get_config_for_27b selects GEMMA_2, 46 layers, width 4608, intermediate size 36864, 32 query and 16 KV heads of width 128. Defaults are vocabulary 256000, context 8192, BF16 and quant=False. Four normalization vectors are enabled per layer. Reopened the pinned raw configuration October 27, 2026; the 27B dimensions remain unchanged.

sources.title: Official Gemma PyTorch model implementation, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Nonquantized 27B implementation has bias-free QKV/output projections, three dense MLP matrices, four learned RMSNorm vectors per layer and final RMSNorm. Output sampling reuses the input embedding matrix. RoPE is a computed buffer; optional quantization scalers are absent with quant=False. Reopened the pinned raw implementation October 27, 2026. It supports the existing total reconciliation but does not separately publish a nominal active count.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: Gemma 2 is explicitly included in the appendix of models governed by the Gemma Terms of Use; current page last modified April 1, 2026.

sources.title: Beyond the Chatbot: Agentic AI with Gemma
sources.evidence: February 13, 2025 guide recommends Gemma 2 27B and describes limited built-in function calling. It demonstrates adding tool instructions and a ReAct text format to obtain function requests; this does not establish a native structured tool-call protocol for the exact checkpoint.

sources.title: Official checkpoint first shard header probe
sources.evidence: HTTP Range bytes=0-7 request returned 401 Unauthorized. Direct raw config, index and tokenizer requests also returned 401; no shard headers or weight payload were downloaded.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-report check. Table 5 explicitly includes Gemma-2-27B-it at nominal 27B under the total-parameter column. Other Gemma 2 comparisons concern capability; no separate active count is disclosed for this exact model.

sources.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 later-disclosure check. The explicit 3.8B activated count belongs to Gemma 4 26B-A4B, not Gemma 2. The paper supplies no retrospective active count for Gemma 2 27B IT; no successor value is transferred.

sources.title: Use Gemma open models
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model search located and reopened the current Google comparison. It lists Gemma 2 27B, including instruction tuning, with nominal 27-billion parameter size. Only the Gemma 4 MoE row explicitly distinguishes active parameters; the Gemma 2 row is not an active-count specification.

sources.title: Phi-4, Microsoft Research, January 2025
sources.evidence: Fresh search traced the reproduced chart to this original Microsoft PDF. Visually inspected page 1: its Active Parameters (Billion) axis places the exact Gemma-2-27B-Instruct point at approximately 27B. This supports a rounded benchmark convention, not an exact active tensor count or a Google specification; no coordinate table is supplied.

sources.title: Phi-4 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Followed the January 2025 PDF reference and read the original report October 27. It provides no separate Gemma 2 active-parameter row or definition refining the comparative plot. The approximate plot value is not promoted to an exact count.

name.note: Makes the instruction-tuned variant explicit; the frozen ID ends in -it.

developer.note: The model card identifies Google as author.

family.note: Gemma 2 is part of the Gemma family.

release_date.note: The dated first-party launch explicitly includes 27B instruction-tuned variants. Earlier repository creation/upload dates and the implementation update are not treated as public model launch dates.

open_weights.note: Google released downloadable model weights; accepting the Gemma license is required for this hosted repository.

license.note: Gemma Terms of Use; the model card declares license: gemma.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique learned count for the released BF16 checkpoint: 256000*4608 + 46*(3*4608*36864 + 2*4608*(32+16)*128 + 4*4608) + 4608 = 27,227,128,320. The tied embedding/output matrix is counted once; computed RoPE buffers and optional quantization scalers are excluded. This independent implementation derivation exactly matches the pinned repository BF16 aggregation. The paper uses 256128 vocabulary rows and totals 27,227,718,144, larger by 128*4608 = 589,824. Direct tensor-header access was gated; this is a source/metadata reconciliation, not a header-by-header recount. Fresh October 27 original-source review reconfirmed the pinned aggregation and implementation dimensions; retain the established exact total without repeating the tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Approximately 27B nominal active parameters in Microsoft Research’s exact-model benchmark plot. This is a published comparative counting convention, not a separate Google disclosure or an exact per-token tensor census. Retain the plot’s rounded precision; do not substitute the precise total or nonembedding subtotal. Original and later Google sources disclose totals only.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer: every layer has ordinary dense attention and feedforward matrices, with GQA and alternating 4096 local / 8192 global attention; the implementation has no expert routing.

context_window.note: Paper context length and implementation max_position_embeddings both equal 8192; the 4096 sliding window applies only to alternating local layers.

modalities.note: The exact model card describes text input and generated text output.

reasoning.note: General reasoning capability and reasoning benchmarks do not establish a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode. No explicit positive or negative classification for that feature was found in these sources; clear the baseline false.

tool_call.note: The standard checkpoint chat template handles user/model text; Google shows prompt-based ReAct tool use while describing built-in support as limited. This does not settle native structured tool-call support for the exact checkpoint, so neither a categorical true nor false is verified.

description.value: Gemma 2 27B instruction-tuned text model with a dense decoder-only Transformer and an 8,192-token context window.
description.note: Replaces vague efficiency/deployment phrasing with verified variant, modality, architecture and context facts.

patch.name: Gemma 2 27B IT
patch.description: Gemma 2 27B instruction-tuned text model with a dense decoder-only Transformer and an 8,192-token context window.
patch.notes: Nominal size: 27B. Total is 27,227,128,320 unique learned parameters from pinned BF16 metadata and Google’s implementation; the paper uses 128 additional vocabulary rows. Active size is approximately 27B under Microsoft Research’s benchmark convention, not an exact count or a separate Google specification. A dedicated reasoning mode and native structured tool-call support are not established; prompt-based ReAct tool use is documented.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the exact 27.22712832B total after reopening pinned metadata, Google implementation and the original technical report. Adds approximately 27B nominal active size from Microsoft Research’s exact-model comparative plot, with its precision and non-Google provenance explicit. Later Google tables use totals and do not independently define active size. All unrelated field assessments and corrections remain unchanged.
